draft_en.subject: PoE switches behind your IP and HD-CVI installations
draft_en.body:
Hello IP CCTV team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 13 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches behind your IP and HD-CVI installations, neutral packing, CE/RoHS, from single units: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); for outdoor cabinets, a DIN-rail industrial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged unit - STI-288GP - $59.8.

One question: do your projects more often need standard PoE+ reach, or extended-distance PoE beyond 100 m?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
